typography.instructions: Import fonts from Google Fonts in index.html or CSS. Use Chivo for all headings to give a tech/industrial feel. Use JetBrains Mono for all pricing, SKUs, and technical data.

primary.name: Tech Cyan
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key highlights

secondary.name: Slate
secondary.usage: Secondary buttons, card backgrounds in dark mode

theme_strategy.light: Swiss High-Contrast. White backgrounds, stark black text, Cyan accents. Best for PDF generation and office use.
theme_strategy.dark: Control Room. Deep Slate backgrounds, glowing Cyan accents. Best for field work and low-light environments.

spacing.base: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Minimum padding p-6 for cards.

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid (Mode B). Dense, data-heavy. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
grid_system.quote_builder: Split View. Left: Client/Settings (1 col). Right: Items/Calcs (2 cols). Sticky summary footer on mobile.

cards.style: Glassmorphism in Dark Mode (bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border-slate-800). Solid Border in Light Mode (bg-white border-slate-200 shadow-sm).

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-600 text-white font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20 transition-all hover:scale-[1.02]
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700

inputs.style: h-12 bg-transparent border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500 rounded-lg
inputs.labels: text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1.5 block

tables.header: bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-medium py-3 px-4
tables.row: border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use for active quote sections. A subtle glowing border that follows focus.
visual_enhancers.gradients: NO full screen gradients. Use subtle radial gradients for 'glow' effects behind charts or key metrics in dark mode.

login_bg.usage: Login screen background with heavy dark overlay (bg-slate-950/90)

logo.placeholder: Use a text-based logo 'TECNO DIAS' with 'TECNO' in Slate-900 (Dark: White) and 'DIAS' in Cyan-500. Font: Chivo Black.

motion.list_entrance: Staggered fade-in for dashboard cards and list items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on Cyan-500 is White. Ensure text on Slate-900 is Slate-50.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-cyan-500 ring-offset-2) for all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
